MIN(fr.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(fr.AREA) AS area_variance FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ff.FLOOR, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON ic.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY WHERE ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 5000","WITH inner_cte AS (WITH floors_with_rooms AS (SELECT DISTINCT ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ff.FLOOR, ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND ff.FLOOR = fr.FLOOR), academic_buildings AS (SELECT DISTINCT fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh WHERE fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT') SELECT ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) - MIN(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_range, VARIANCE(fwr.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS assignable_area_variance FROM academic_buildings AS ab JOIN floors_with_rooms AS fwr ON ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fwr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ab.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ab.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY ic.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ic.assignable_area_range, ic.assignable_area_variance, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY"]}

react.initial_search_query: List the names of the buildings with the most floors. If there are ties, list each one separately.

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_NAME, t2.BUILDING_NUMBER, t1.FLOOR, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, t0.POSTAL_CODE, t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE' AND t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND t2.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t2.BUILDING_NAME = 'MACLAURIN BUILDINGS (3)') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE, FloorCounts.Total_Floors, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.POSTAL_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.FLOOR) AS Total_Floors FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t2 JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS t1 ON t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY GROUP BY t2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS FloorCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = FloorCounts.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE

WITH top10_academic_buildings AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count FROM `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY room_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.room_count, muc.MAJOR_USE_DESC AS Most_Common_Major_Use, muc.Major_Use_Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, COUNT(*) AS Major_Use_Room_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS muc ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = muc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND muc.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.room_count DESC), academic_building_access2_rooms AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.num_rooms, (ic.num_rooms - (SELECT AVG(num_rooms) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME) SELECT t.BUILDING_NAME, t.room_count, t.Most_Common_Major_Use, t.Major_Use_Room_Count, a.num_rooms AS num_rooms_access_level_2, a.deviation_from_avg FROM top10_academic_buildings AS t LEFT JOIN academic_building_access2_rooms AS a ON t.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = a.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t.room_count DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS` AS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.AREA, (ic.AREA - avg_floor_area.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR) AS avg_floor_area ON ic.FLOOR = avg_floor_area.FLOOR) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.BUILDING_NUMBER, s1.POSTAL_CODE, s1.row_num_window, s2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.AREA AS s2_AREA, s2.area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NUMBER = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.AREA

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS rw JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAveragesPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, COUNT(sd2.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME) AS TOTAL_ROOMS_ON_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, raf.TOTAL_ROOMS_ON_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAveragesPerFloor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN `SPACE_DETAIL` AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sf.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS FLOOR_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME JOIN `SPACE_FLOOR` AS sf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = sf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH student_info AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 JOIN `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t0 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), dept_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED`), dept_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, (STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(TOTAL_UNITS), 0)) AS coefficient_of_variation, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM dept_units GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.avg_total_units, avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < avg_stats.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, d.coefficient_of_variation, d.avg_total_units,
